book.name: 1 Abhakoriinto
book.title: Enyaarubha yo okutaanga ya Pauro ku Bhakoriinto

content: Amaragiriryo iguru yo obhukweeri
Bhoono niragaamba iguru ya amangʼana gano mwaanikaamiiri. Muragaamba kubha, “Ni bhuzomu omusubhe atige okuhiindira no omukari.”
Nawe kwo okubha murakora obhuseebheeti, omusubhe wowoosi abhe no omukari waaye omweene, no omukari wowoosi abhe no omusubhe waaye omweene.
Omusubhe abhe aramukorera omukari waaye kyeego ekweenderwa, no omukari woosi abhe aramukorera omusubhe waaye kyeego ekweenderwa.

Omukari atana obhunagya iguru yo omubhiri gwaaye, nawe omusubhe waaye niwe wo obhunagya iguru yo omubhiri guyo. Neewe omusubhe atana obhunagya iguru yo omubhiri gwaaye, nawe omukari waaye niwe wo obhunagya iguru yo omubhiri gwaaye.

Mutiiyiima, nawe eraabhe mwiikirireenie kukora ego kwiibhaga, okubha mubhone omweeya muzomu gwo okusabha ku Taatabhugya. Ibhaga riindi, mukyoorerane kweeki, okubha Seetaani ataaza kubhasakya kukora obhuseebheeti kwo okubha mutakunagya okwiibhaaha.
Nibhabhuuriiri amangʼana iguru yo okutaana kwiibhaga, nirabhatoongera ego, etari kwo okubhahatika.
Bhoono, niingaseegiri abhaatu bhoosi bhabhe kyeego enye niri,
nawe etari ego kwo okubha omuutu wuyo woosi Taatabhugya amuheeri obhuturo bhwaaye, owumwe obhuturo bhuno, owuundi bhurya.
Bhoono, ndabhabhuurira abhaguru na abhatuumba gati weenyu, ni bhuzomu bhageenderere okwiikara ego okutama okukweera kasi okukweerwa, bhabhe kyeego enye niri.
Nawe eraabhe bhakutamwa okwiibhaaha, ni bhuzomu bhakweere kasi okukweerwa, kwo okubha ni hakiriku okukora ego kukira okubha ne enaamba yo omubhiri.
Kubhano bhiikweeriri, nirabhaha obhuswaagyo. Obhuswaagyo bhuyo bhutari bhwaane, nawe bhurwiiri ku Mukuru Yeesu, kubha, omukari atatwaanikana no omusubhe waaye.
Nawe eraabhe atwaanikeeni neewe, atakweerwa no omusubhe wuundi, hamwe, yiigwaane no omusubhe waaye no okukyoorerana. No omusubhe woosi, atamutiga omukari waaye.

Bhoono niragaamba na abhiikirirya abhaandi. Amangʼana gano nikugaamba ni miiseego gaane, gatari obhuswaagyo bhwo Omukuru Yeesu. Kyo omusubhe omwiikirirya akweeriri omukari wuno atari mwiikirirya, no omukari wuyo yiikiriirye okwiikara neewe, atamutiga.
Egoego, omukari omwiikirirya, neewe akweerirwe no omusubhe wuno atari mwiikirirya, no omusubhe wuyo yiikiriirye okwiikara neewe, atamutiga.

Niragaamba ego, kwo okubha Taatabhugya amwiikiriirye omusubhe wuno atari mwiikirirya, kwe ekigirirye kyo omukari waaye. No omukari wuno atari omwiikirirya, Taatabhugya amwiikiriirye kwe ekigirirye kyo omusubhe waaye. Eraabhe etaangabheeri ego, abhaana bheenyu bhataangabheeri abhahoreeru bha Taatabhugya, nawe bhoono ni bhahoreeru bha Taatabhugya.

Nawe, eraabhe wuno atari mwiikirirya areenda okutaana no omurikyaaye omwiikirirya, mutige akore ego. Hayo omwiikirirya wuyo, atakubhohwa no obhukweeri bhuyo, nawe Taatabhugya atubhirikiiri okubha twiikare kwo omureembe.

Awe omukari omwiikirirya, otakunagya okumenya! Hamwe omusubhe waazo arabhona okumwiikirirya Krisito kwiiguru wo obhwiikirirya bhwaazo. Naawe omusubhe omwiikirirya, otakunagya kumenya! Hamwe omukari waazo arabhona okumwiikirirya Krisito kwiiguru wo obhwiikirirya bhwaazo.
Abhiikirirya bhiikare kyeego bhabhirikiirwe na Taatabhugya
Omuutu wowoosi yiikare kuriingʼaana na kyeego Omukuru akumweendera, na kyeego Taatabhugya yamubhirikiiri. Ego niigo nikuswaagya mumakanisa goosi.
Eraabhe omuutu yabhirikiirwe na Taatabhugya, eriibhaga yaari asaarirwe,
atiikora kyeego atasaarirwe. Kweeki, eraabhe omuutu akabhirikirwa na Taatabhugya eriibhaga yaari atasaarirwe, atasaarwa.
Okusaarwa no okutama kusaarwa bhutariho obhweera. Kigiro kino kino obhweera ni kugwaata obhuswaagyo bhwa Taatabhugya.
Bhoono, omuutu wuyo woosi atame kyeego yaari hano Taatabhugya yamubhirikiiri.
Eraabhe Taatabhugya yakubhirikiiri hano waari mugya, riyo ritakunyaakya. Nawe eraabhe oraabhone omweeya gwo okwiiragaanza, okorere omweeya guyo.

Nibhugiri kubha, riyo ritakunyaakya, kwo okubha omuutu wuno yaari mugya hano yabhirikiirwe no Omukuru, wuyo arabha omwiiragaanzi ku Mukuru. Neewe wuno yabhirikiirwe hano yaari omwiiragaanzi, wuyo ni mugya wa Krisito.
Mukagurwa kwo obhuguri bhukuru. Kweego, mutabha abhagya bha abhaatu.
Abhahiiri bhaane, omuutu wuyo woosi atame embere wa Taatabhugya, kyeego yaari hano yabhirikiirwe neewe.
Amaragiriryo kubhano bhatakweerirwe na kubhatuumba
Bhoono, kubhaakya bhano bhatakweerirwe,
nitana eriiswaagyo okurwa ku Mukuru Yeesu. Nawe nirabheerekeererya kwa miiseego gaane, enye wuno nikungʼarira okwiikiriribhwa kwe ekigirirye kye ebhigoongi bhya Taatabhugya.
Ambe, kwo okubha ziriho eziinyaako nzaru eziisiku zino, niriiseega ni bhuzomu omuutu atame kyeego ari.
Eraabhe okweeriri, otatigana na mukaazo. Eraabhe okyaari kukweera, otakweera.

Nawe eraabhe oraakweere, otakubha okoriri kibhi. No omuukya neewe, araakweerwe, atakubha akoriri kibhi. Nawe, bhano bhakweereeni bharabha ne eziinyaako mubhwiikari bhwaabhu. Neenye niingaseegiri eziinyaako ziyo zitaaza kubhabhona.

Abhahiiri bhaane, ndeenda okugaamba kubha, eriibhaga rino risaagiri ni iguhi, tee Krisito akyoore. Kweego, okurwa bhoono bhano bhakweeriri bhatige okwiiseega iguru wa abhakari bhaabhu ego, okubha bhakore emirimo gyo Omukuru.
Na bhano bhakurira, bhano bhakuzomererwa, bhano bhakugura ebhigiro,
na bhano bhakukorera obhwiikari bhwa mukyaaro kino, bhayo bhoosi bhatanyaakira bhukongʼu amangʼana gayo. Bhabhe bharakora emirimo gyo Omukuru, kwo okubha ekyaaro kino kyeego tukukirora, kirahita.
Ndeenda mutabha no obhwiitiimaati iguru ya amangʼana go obhwiikari bhuno. Omuutu wuno akyaari kukweera, ariinyaakya iguru ye emirimo gyo Omukuru, na ariiseega kyeego araamuzomeerye Omukuru.
Nawe omuutu wuno akweeriri, ahaanyaakira amangʼana go obhwiikari bhwaabhu, akwiiseega kyeego araamuzomeerye omukari waaye,

amiiseego gaaye gari mbaara ibhiri. Omukari kasi omuukya wuno atakweerirwe aramuhokeerya Omukuru, okubha abhe muhoreeru omubhiri ne ekoro. Nawe omukari wuno akweerirwe, ahaanyaakira amangʼana go obhwiikari bhuno, ariiseega kyeego araamuzomeerye omusubhe waaye.
Niragaamba amangʼana gayo kwo obhweera bhweenyu, etari kubha ndeenda kubharekya. Ndeenda mubhe muriikara kyeego ekweenderwa, mubhe muramuhokeerya Omukuru kwe ekoro yoosi.
Omuutu wowoosi wuno akurora kubha etari bhuzomu okutiga kumukweera omuukya wuno amuyuungirye, kweeki eraabhe enaamba yo omubhiri emuhiziri,
omuutu wuyo ararora kubha, ereenderwa bhiikweere, akore kyeego akweenda, bhakweerane. Hayo atakubha akoriri ebhibhi.
Na eraabhe omuutu araamure mukoro yaaye kubha, atakumukweera omuukya wuyo, na kitariho ekigiro kino kikumuhatika okukweera, kweeki aranagya okubhaaha obhuseegi bhwaaye, ambe, arabha akoriri bhuzomu.
Kweego, wuno akwaamura kumukweera omuukya wuno amuyuungirye, arakora bhuzomu. Na wuno atakumukweera, arakora kisi bhukongʼu.

Omukari wuno akweerirwe, abhohirwe no obhukweerwa eriibhaga ryoosi rino omusubhe waaye akyaari muhoru. Nawe eraabhe omusubhe waaye akuuri, hayo arabha omwiiragaanzi okukweerwa no omusubhe wowoosi wuno akweenda, nawe omusubhe wuyo abhe omwaanamweega wo Omukuru.
Nawe hakiriku omutuumba wuyo asaage atakweerwa. Gayo ni miiseego gaane, na niriiseega kubha enye woosi Ekoro wa Taatabhugya aranikaangata okugaamba amangʼana gayo.

Hano Pauro arakeerenia kubha atakweeriri, na bhuyo nibhwo obhuturo bhwaaye.
Asaarirwe. Rora okusaarwa mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
Kubhaakya bhano bhatakweerirwe, obhugazuro obhuundi bhuratura kubha, kubhano bhakyaari kukweera kasi okukweerwa.
Kweeki eraabhe enaamba yo omubhiri emuhiziri, obhugazuro obhuundi bhuratura kubha, kweeki naabhe emyaaka gyaaye gyo okukweerwa gihitiri.

-38 Obhugazuro obhuundi bhuratura kubha, Omuutu wowoosi wuno akurora etari bhuzomu okutiga kumukweerya omuukya wuno ayuungirye, hamwe emyaaka gyaaye gyo okukweerwa gihitiri, no omuutu wuyo ararora kubha, ereenderwa amukweere, akore kyeego akweenda, amukweere. Hayo atakubha akoriri ebhibhi. Na kyo omuutu yamwiiri mukoro yaaye omweene kubha atakumukweerya omuukya waaye, na kitariho kigiro kino kikumuhatika kumukweerya, kweeki aranagya okukaangata obhuseegi bhwaaye, ambe, arabha akoriri kisi. Kweego, omuutu wuno akwaamura kumukweerya omuukya waaye wuno ayuungiibhwe, arakora bhuzomu. Neewe wuno atakumukweerya, arakora kisi.
